<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 500 420" width="500" height="420">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Styles for standard O/A Level exam look -->
  <style>
    text {
      font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
      font-size: 16px;
      fill: #000000;
    }
    .sans-text {
      font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: 15px;
      fill: #000000;
    }
    .label-text {
      font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-style: italic;
      fill: #000000;
    }
    line, path, rect, circle, polygon {
      stroke: #000000;
      stroke-width: 1.5;
      fill: none;
      stroke-linecap: round;
      stroke-linejoin: round;
    }
    .ground-hatch {
      stroke-width: 1;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Ground / Wedge base -->
  <!-- Wedge points: bottom-left (100, 320), bottom-right (350, 320), top-right (350, 100) -->
  <!-- Let's calculate top-right based on 30 degrees angle at bottom-left -->
  <!-- angle = 30 deg. base width = 250. height = 250 * tan(30) = 250 * 0.57735 = 144.3 -->
  
  <polygon points="80,320 370,320 370,153.2" fill="#f8f8f8" />
  
  <!-- Ground line under wedge -->
  <line x1="50" y1="320" x2="400" y2="320" />
  
  <!-- Hatching for ground -->
  <g class="ground-hatch">
    <line x1="80" y1="320" x2="70" y2="332" />
    <line x1="110" y1="320" x2="100" y2="332" />
    <line x1="140" y1="320" x2="130" y2="332" />
    <line x1="170" y1="320" x2="160" y2="332" />
    <line x1="200" y1="320" x2="190" y2="332" />
    <line x1="230" y1="320" x2="220" y2="332" />
    <line x1="260" y1="320" x2="250" y2="332" />
    <line x1="290" y1="320" x2="280" y2="332" />
    <line x1="320" y1="320" x2="310" y2="332" />
    <line x1="350" y1="320" x2="340" y2="332" />
    <line x1="380" y1="320" x2="370" y2="332" />
  </g>

  <!-- Inclined plane surface (hypotenuse) from (80, 320) to (370, 153.2) -->
  <line x1="80" y1="320" x2="370" y2="153.2" />

  <!-- Vertical back of wedge -->
  <line x1="370" y1="153.2" x2="370" y2="320" />

  <!-- Pulley at the top corner (370, 153.2) -->
  <!-- Pulley circle radius = 10 -->
  <circle cx="370" cy="143.2" r="10" />
  <circle cx="370" cy="143.2" r="2" fill="#000" />
  <!-- Bracket fixing pulley -->
  <path d="M 370,133.2 L 370,120 L 360,120" />

  <!-- 4.0 kg Block on the incline -->
  <!-- Center of block roughly along slope. Let's place it around middle of slope. -->
  <!-- Distance along slope from (80,320). Let's use distance L = 180. -->
  <!-- x = 80 + 180 * cos(30) = 80 + 180 * 0.866 = 235.9 -->
  <!-- y = 320 - 180 * sin(30) = 320 - 180 * 0.5 = 230 -->
  <!-- We want the block rotated by -30 degrees. -->
  <g transform="translate(235.9, 230) rotate(-30)">
    <!-- Block dimensions: width = 50, height = 30. Centered so rect is (-25, -30 to 0) or similar -->
    <rect x="-25" y="-30" width="50" height="30" fill="#ffffff" />
    <text x="0" y="-10" text-anchor="middle" class="sans-text">4.0 kg</text>
  </g>

  <!-- String from block to pulley -->
  <!-- Block top-right corner in world coords: -->
  <!-- Let's calculate attachment point directly: -->
  <!-- Slope direction vector: (cos30, -sin30) = (0.866, -0.5) -->
  <!-- Center of block is at (235.9, 230). Top edge is at offset y' = -30 in local coords, which means normal offset. -->
  <!-- Let's just draw line from block upper-right to pulley -->
  <!-- Block upper-right attachment approx: translate(235.9, 230) rotate(-30) -> local (25, -30) -->
  <!-- World coords for (25, -30) under rot(-30), trans(235.9, 230): -->
  <!-- x = 235.9 + 25*cos(-30) - (-30)*sin(-30) = 235.9 + 21.65 - 15 = 242.55 -->
  <!-- y = 230 + 25*sin(-30) + (-30)*cos(-30) = 230 - 12.5 - 25.98 = 191.52 -->
  <line x1="244.5" y1="190.4" x2="360" y2="143.2" />

  <!-- String from pulley to hanging mass -->
  <!-- Pulley edge is at (380, 143.2) or top is (370, 133.2), right is (380, 143.2) -->
  <line x1="380" y1="143.2" x2="380" y2="250" />

  <!-- Hanging 3.0 kg mass -->
  <rect x="360" y="250" width="40" height="50" fill="#ffffff" />
  <text x="380" y="280" text-anchor="middle" class="sans-text">3.0 kg</text>
  <line x1="380" y1="300" x2="380" y2="315" /> <!-- short string under mass -->

  <!-- 30 degree angle arc at bottom-left -->
  <path d="M 120,320 A 40,40 0 0,0 114.6,299.8" />
  <text x="130" y="305" class="sans-text">30°</text>

  <!-- Labels with pointer lines -->
  <!-- Rough plane label -->
  <text x="130" y="225" class="sans-text">rough plane</text>
  <line x1="180" y1="225" x2="200" y2="250" />
  <circle cx="200" cy="250" r="2" fill="#000" />

  <!-- Smooth pulley label -->
  <text x="400" y="110" class="sans-text">smooth pulley</text>
  <path d="M 400,115 L 385,135" />
  <circle cx="380" cy="143.2" r="2" fill="#000" />

  <!-- Caption -->
  <text x="250" y="380" text-anchor="middle" class="sans-text">Fig. 1.1</text>

</svg>

  <!-- Vertical back of wedge -->

  <!-- Pulley at the top corner (390, 172.6) -->

  <circle cx="390" cy="162.6" r="2" fill="#000" />

  <!-- y = 240 + 25*sin(-30) + (-30)*cos(-30) = 240 - 12.5 - 25.98 = 201.52 -->
  <line x1="281.8" y1="200.4" x2="380" y2="162.6" />

  <!-- String from pulley to hanging mass -->
  <line x1="400" y1="162.6" x2="400" y2="260" />

  <!-- Hanging 3.0 kg mass -->

  <text x="400" y="291" text-anchor="middle" class="sans-text">3.0 kg</text>
  <line x1="400" y1="310" x2="400" y2="325" /> <!-- short string under mass -->

  <!-- 30 degree angle arc at bottom-left -->
  <path d="M 145,340 A 45,45 0 0,0 139.0,317.5" />
  <text x="155" y="325" class="sans-text">30°</text>

  <!-- Labels with pointer lines -->
  <!-- Rough plane label -->

  <line x1="185" y1="225" x2="225" y2="263" />
  <circle cx="225" cy="263" r="2" fill="#000" />

  <!-- Smooth pulley label -->
  <text x="430" y="125" class="sans-text">smooth pulley</text>
  <path d="M 430,130 L 405,155" />
  <circle cx="400" cy="162.6" r="2" fill="#000" />

  <!-- Caption -->
  <text x="275" y="405" text-anchor="middle" class="sans-text">Fig. 1.1</text>
